_readme: VPS WireGuard & OpenClaw — Configuration. Fill values below, then run: sudo bash setup.sh

openclaw._comment: OpenClaw AI assistant. Bot token from Discord and API key from OpenAI. Leave hooks_token and gateway_token empty to generate secure values automatically.

wireguard._comment: WireGuard server. If private_key is empty a new key pair is generated. Add one entry per implant/peer in the peers array.
